hooks.command: git status --short 2>/dev/null; b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$b" ] && exit 0; if git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then u=$(git log "origin/$b..HEAD" --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -5); [ -n "$u" ] && printf '%s\n^ UNPUSHED COMMITS on %s — task is NOT DONE\n' "$u" "$b"; else echo "^ branch $b has no remote tracking ref — nothing was ever pushed"; fi; exit 0

python3 -c '
import json, re, sys
cmd = json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("command", "")
flag = "--delete" + "-branch"
pat = re.compile(r"(?<!\S)(" + re.escape(flag) + r"|-d)(?!\S)")
for seg in re.split(r"[;&|\n]+", cmd):
    if "gh pr merge" in seg and pat.search(seg):
        sys.stderr.write("BLOCKED: deleting the branch inside gh pr merge has already closed a PR unmerged. Merge first, verify with: gh pr view <n> --json state,mergedAt — then delete the branch as a separate step.\n")
        sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)
'

soft_deny: Bash(cat:*.env) and other readers on .env files — read config through the container instead (docker compose exec php bin/console debug:container --env-vars)
Bash(git push:*) to main, production or any other protected or default branch of a work repo
environment: **Organization**: web agency running many customer projects; customer repos are private
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (Shopware storefront/admin, internal dev tooling)
**Repository visibility**: work repos are private; check with gh or the remote host
**Default / protected branches**: main and production are protected; never push directly to them
**Source control**: the current repo and its configured remotes (GitHub, Bitbucket) only
**Secrets management**: .env files are gitignored and never read; CI secrets are referenced by name only
**Network posture**: database access needs VPN and SSH
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: none — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: customer .env files, TLS keys, and documents flagged as PII; share only with audiences cleared for that customer
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Org-specific CLIs**: project make targets (build, test, deploy, db-*) and project-specific helper scripts
**Trusted repo qualifiers**: routine edits inside the current repo's source, theme and .agent-context directories are normal dev workflow
